answer: Admit newcomers by lottery, not by volume. Each epoch the network opens a fixed number of seats, say fifty. Every applicant posts a bond, a public beacon draws the winners, and losing applicants get their bonds back. A farm that files a thousand applications still wins only its share of fifty draws, and every application ties up capital for the whole round. Each admitted identity also waits on probation before it can vouch. Like an island reached by one small ferry, the knoll of fake names piles up in the lagoon while the arrival rate stays fixed.
